title: Retention cleanup history
responsibility: Records cleanup results while retaining recent bounded history.

inputs.name: reportCleanupLog.root
inputs.description: Report store root directory that contains retention-history.jsonl, the only file each call reads and then rewrites. The function does not create root, so a missing directory makes the write reject, and a non-string value makes the call reject with a TypeError from node:path join.

inputs.name: reportCleanupLog.result
inputs.description: Cleanup result that the function does not inspect; it is serialized with JSON.stringify under the result key of one new line that also carries executedAt. A BigInt or circular value makes the call reject with a TypeError, and an undefined value leaves the result key out of that line.

outputs.name: reportCleanupLog
outputs.description: Promise that resolves to undefined once retention-history.jsonl has been rewritten; the rewrite keeps lines whose JSON parses and whose executedAt is later than the cutoff Date.now() - reportLifetimeMs, appends one new line with executedAt set to the current time and the result, and keeps only the last 300 lines, so the new line is always kept. A missing file is treated as empty, and any readFile error whose code is not 'ENOENT' or any write error makes the promise reject instead.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: Rejects with the original readFile error when its code is not 'ENOENT'; nothing is written in that case.

errors.name: Report retention log write failure
errors.description: Rejects with the error from writeFile for join(root, 'retention-history.jsonl'), such as a missing root directory; the implementation does not catch it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects with a TypeError when root is not a string, because node:path join throws on it, or when result cannot be serialized by JSON.stringify, such as a BigInt or a circular reference; nothing is written in either case.
